analysis.d_full: PAPERS WITH CODE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'was a free, open-access platform' linking machine learning papers to code, datasets and benchmarks. History: launched 2018 by Robert Stojnic and Ross Taylor; acquired by Facebook (Meta AI Research) in December 2019; 'Shut down by Meta on July 24, 2025'; the historical dataset on GitHub. Alternatives: 'it initially redirected to Hugging Face Trending Papers'; 'community-driven alternatives like Papers with Code co'. Four cards: the TIB blog, Coursera, a Reddit post on the code opened under Apache 2.0, a video review of PapersWithCode.co.
findings: THE STATUS AND THE FOUNDING RIGHT. Founders, 2018, Facebook's ownership from December 2019 and the sunset of 24 July 2025 are the record's fields (TechCrunch; Hugging Face's announcement as hyper.ai reports it). 'Shut down by Meta' is stated outright; the revival's own README says the original was one 'which Meta retired in 2025'. Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.

THE REDIRECT, TWO WAYS. This composition says the site 'initially redirected to Hugging Face Trending Papers'; the composition at 'is papers with code still active' the same night says it 'redirected users to a static GitHub archive', and the TIB card it cites says users 'were simply redirected to the Papers with Code Github repository'. The record gives Trending Papers, launched by Hugging Face with Meta, as the replacement named at the sunset (hyper.ai).

THE REVIVAL NAMED, LIGHTLY. 'Papers with Code co' appears as a community-driven alternative. The revival at paperswithcode.co, by Niels Rogge of Hugging Face's open-source team, its code at github.com/huggingface/paperswithcode under Apache-2.0, was in the record only as an undated individual effort.
THE BATTERY. Ended: yes. Founders and owner apart: yes. Dumps apart from successors: yes. CodeSOTA presented as Papers with Code: no. A current result attributed to the frozen tables: no.

[SYSTEM] Papers with Code was a free, open-access platform that linked machine learning research papers directly to their source code, datasets, and benchmark results. History and Status

* Creation: Launched in 2018 by Robert Stojnic and Ross Taylor.
* Acquisition: Acquired by Facebook (Meta AI Research) in December 2019.
* Sunset: Shut down by Meta on July 24, 2025.
* Archival Data: The historical dataset remains accessible on the [Papers with Code GitHub Repository](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHrOzAVmOZznLuwxeoG_t7NzJN4j3WtVk85SrhdgKMQo4yP_xM6p6aLP_0IABlBzOMfWddVThpp3gbK3ITrBR_HLG33zxfGEVmscM1JA-aQh5lcwz3UQJWzceA1ve9lKhG0fQed3F8nIaQGuYo). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVnrP7QdleN5oK95IwK3ulgm6S2a1Zu093EoakqgVZ0GlEJxJsCZ_w_Bc3Ckp9UYqcD_TuGXjoZgFojiZENWo7BXziQlPJAa_UW-0gQyHk1Q_1wkqm2gc_JjsnjPkIYcczOvidj6Q)]
